charts.title: Request statistics
charts.description: Analyze request cost and token flow across the selected range, model, site and downstream API key.
charts.empty: No drawable data for the current filters.

filters.applyHint: Click Apply after changing filters; all three views update in parallel.

bar.description: Summarize total cost by model across the selected range, stacking downstream API keys within each model.

sankey.title: Token Sankey
sankey.description: Show token flow from site to model to downstream API key; date is a filter only.
